citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 12:00 PM on 18-
August-2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by knocking on the door and speaking to the licensee's
spouse who stated he would not be available for an inspection today. She also stated they are intending to cancel their
USDA license. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and
regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
